subject: planner: add iter for HandleCols (#59160)
summary: Change adds `IterColumns`/`IterColumns2` to `pkg/planner/util.HandleCols` and updates a few planner/executor loops (DELETE column pruning/index-fixup, FOR UPDATE lock prune, table-scan possible properties, analyze columns pushdown) to iterate via the new iterator APIs. Reviewed the modified call sites and implementations; iteration preserves the prior ordering/indices and does not change SQL semantics, visibility, or transactional/runtime behavior. Checked later history on `upstream/master` for follow-up fixes in the touched areas and found no indication of a Blocker/High issue attributable to this commit.
